entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please state the reason for your call.
Yeah, hi. I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's not working right. The heart rate monitor is all over the place.
Thank you for contacting VeloFit support. I understand you'd like to return your VeloBand Pulse. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase, please?
It's… uh… [customer provides email address]. Just get this thing returned. It's garbage!
Okay, I have your order here. I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse on October 26th. Today is November 10th. Our return window for the VeloBand Pulse is 10 days from the date of purchase.
What?! Seriously? Only 10 days? That's ridiculous! I've barely had it, and it's defective! I want a full refund!

I understand your frustration, but our standard return window is indeed 10 days. I can see how that's not ideal given the circumstances. Let me explore if there is a possibility of a policy exception in this case.
Well, hurry up! I don't have all day. This is costing me money!

Thank you for your patience. I've reviewed your purchase, and while a full refund isn't possible outside the return window, I can offer you store credit for the full purchase price of the VeloBand Pulse. You can use this credit towards any other VeloFit product. How does that sound?
Store credit? Ugh… fine. I guess that's better than nothing. But I'm not happy about this short return window thing.

I understand. I've applied the store credit to your account. You should see it reflected immediately when you log in to our website. You can browse our other products, including newer models of the VeloBand, and use the credit at checkout.
Okay, I see it. So, I can just order something else, and it'll automatically use the credit?

That's correct. At the checkout stage, the store credit will be automatically applied to your order, reducing the total amount you owe. If your new purchase exceeds the amount of the credit, you can simply pay the remaining balance.
Alright. Thanks… I guess. I appreciate you finding a solution.
You're very welcome! We appreciate your business with VeloFit. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, I think that's it. Thanks again.
Have a great day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit!
